patterns: Launch-day wave: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 drove the top of the board, from EHuanglu's 'turn any script into Disney movie' (174.4K, 317 bookmarks) to minchoi's '10 wild examples' thread (35.7K, 173 bookmarks). The script-to-movie promise travels best.

The 'famous IP, but it's 1977' format holds for a fourth day: techhalla's Pokémon (41.3K views, 1,041 likes, 268 bookmarks), Astérix & Obélix (11.3K) and Braveheart 1974 (8.2K). Titles of five words or fewer, the clip does the work.
Early-access model tests pull reach but weak engagement: CharaspowerAI's MiniMax H3 Image got 94.8K views and 30 likes; MayorKingAI's 4-model Seedream 5.5 shootout got 6.4K.
Transformation clips earn saves: azed_ai's '2D to 3D' character got 106 bookmarks on 12.3K views (about 0.9%).
Outsider angle: editing a generated shot afterwards (IronSage_ on Magnific Move, 48.2K) beats raw generation demos.
